title: The image returned by `RenderingServer.texture_2d_get` in tool script is cached
body:
### Tested versions

4.5, 4.4.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev.mono - EndeavourOS  SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 07 Apr 2025 19:59:13 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

The image returned by `RenderingServer.texture_2d_get` in tool script is cached, when it's modified, the image obtained subsequently is also modified, unless I manually update the texture using `RenderingServer.texture_2d_update`.

The reason is https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/215acd52e82f4c575abb715e25e54558deeef998/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/texture_storage.h#L176
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/215acd52e82f4c575abb715e25e54558deeef998/drivers/gles3/storage/texture_storage.h#L194-L195

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
@tool
extends Node2D

func _ready() -> void:
	var t:Texture2D=load("res://icon.svg")
	var img:=RenderingServer.texture_2d_get(t.get_rid())
	var orignal_img:Image=img.duplicate()
	print("original size: ",img.get_size())
	img.resize(16,16)
	print("after resize: ",RenderingServer.texture_2d_get(t.get_rid()).get_size())
	RenderingServer.texture_2d_update(t.get_rid(),orignal_img,0)
	print("after update: ",RenderingServer.texture_2d_get(t.get_rid()).get_size())
```
In editor tool script:
```
original size: (128, 128)
after resize: (16, 16)
after update: (128, 128)
```
Run the game:
```
original size: (128, 128)
after resize: (128, 128)
after update: (128, 128)
```
